Demonstrates a possible future workflow; it does NOT predict patient treatment response and makes NO efficacy or treatment-recommendation claim.
disclaimers: A recorded drug–gene interaction does not establish efficacy for this sample or for osteosarcoma.
Ranked genes are predicted dependencies, not therapeutic targets or recommended drugs.
This artifact does not predict patient treatment response or recommend any therapy.

retrieval.method: evidence.get_evidence_for_gene(entrez_id, symbol) by Entrez ID only; symbol is a flagged consistency check, never a key

environment.scikit_learn: not used by case_study.py (inference is fitted_artifacts only)

limitations: Both models are RECONSTRUCTED fitted state, not the historical Phase 1 fitted objects (which were never serialised). They reproduce every committed Phase 1 validation statistic exactly at the recorded precision, but remain a reconstruction.
ACH-000364 is ONE held-out cell line: a pipeline-verification example, not a performance measurement. Its observed CRISPR values are shown for inspection only.
BG003082 is bulk primary-tumour tissue scored by models trained and validated only on cultured DepMap cell lines -- a real domain shift. Its prediction is exploratory; no ground truth exists.
BG003082's Geneformer embedding was generated separately; its commensurability with the Phase 1 training embeddings is not proven (see samples.BG003082.head_input.commensurability_caveats).
BG003082 baseline input resolves 18427 / 18,460 canonical genes; the remaining 33 are represented as missing and receive the artifact's stored training-mean imputation.
The osteosarcoma aggregate is descriptive and unstable (n=5); it is not a confidence-bounded result and does not replace the frozen Phase 1 primary comparison.
Drug-gene interaction evidence is retrieval from a licence-filtered offline DGIdb snapshot: not treatments, not recommendations, no efficacy claim. PMIDs are drug-gene / source-group level citations.

methodology.determinism: fixed-precision floats (predictions 10 dp, aggregate 6 dp), sorted keys, fixed list order, no wall-clock, no absolute paths, byte-identical on regeneration
methodology.inference: fitted_artifacts.py only -- closed-form array arithmetic; case_study.py imports no scikit-learn and calls no fit()/fit_transform()
methodology.models: ridge_pca and ridge_head, loaded as reconstructed fitted state at the frozen Phase 1 alpha from the unchanged frozen training data (NOT the unavailable historical fitted objects)
methodology.no_leakage: no observed CRISPR value enters any prediction or ranking; evidence retrieval runs only after the top-N is frozen and never changes it

cohort.predicate: config.osteosarcoma_mask(model_metadata) [OncotreePrimaryDisease / OncotreeSubtype keyword] intersected with splits.json assignment == 'val'

common_finite_target_set.excluded_reason: at n=5, a target is excluded when it has <5 finite (observed, predicted) pairs or a constant column for either model
common_finite_target_set.rule: targets whose per-target Spearman is finite for BOTH models

osteosarcoma_validation_aggregate.per_target_metric: baseline.per_target_spearman(observed, predicted) across the 5 cohort lines (min_samples=5; a constant column -> NaN); rules unchanged from Phase 1
osteosarcoma_validation_aggregate.status: DESCRIPTIVE and UNSTABLE because n=5. No confidence interval, no significance test. This does NOT replace or restate the frozen Phase 1 primary result (val per-target Spearman 0.2356 vs 0.2047 over 170 held-out cell lines); it is shown only so ACH-000364's single-line result is not read as cherry-picked.

BG003082.description: Sid Sijbrandij osteosarcoma primary-tumour RNA-seq, osteosarc.com, CC0 1.0, resected 2022-12-16; bulk tumour tissue, a real domain shift from cultured DepMap cell lines

commensurability_caveats: SEPARATELY GENERATED external embedding: produced on Kaggle by capstone/kaggle_bg003082_embedding.py, not part of the frozen 1,140-row geneformer_embeddings.csv.
The historical Phase 1 Geneformer code revision was NOT captured; this sidecar pins revision 04c2b2e8..., a fresh pin for this run.
Commensurability of this embedding with the Phase 1 training embeddings is NOT proven (bulk primary-tumour TPM input; NCBI gene2ensembl map, not the vanished mygene map; fresh revision pin).
The BG003082 prediction is EXPLORATORY and cannot be interpreted as validated model performance.
provenance_disclosures: Bulk primary-tumour TPM, not raw-count scRNA-seq: schema-compatible but scientifically out of distribution for a model trained on cultured DepMap cell lines.
Pseudo-count basis is linear TPM, identical to the frozen 1,140 training embeddings (log2(TPM+1) -> 2**x - 1 round-trips to TPM). Real RSEM counts were available and deliberately not used.
Entrez->Ensembl map is NCBI gene2ensembl; the training embeddings used a mygene map that no longer exists in the repo. Provenance differs even though the join key (Entrez) is the same.
This embedding is NOT reproducible from the public repository (needs Geneformer + a GPU). Same reproducibility asymmetry as the Phase 1 Geneformer arm, plus the map-provenance difference above.

BG003082.observed_outcome: none exists; none is loaded, invented, or computed for this sample

title: Phase 2 proof-of-concept case study
